messages:
external_auditor_jones: Hi Redwood team — for the SOC2 sample we need chain-of-custody and KMS/HSM evidence covering Nov 6–12 2024. Specifically: rotation events (who, when, artifacts), access events for keystore exports, and the raw audit logs that show the billing job export attempt. Can you confirm retention window and provide replayable repro steps? Deadline EOD Wed.

emily-security: Thanks — got it. We'll prepare: (1) rotation timeline + artifacts, (2) filtered access logs with principals and source IPs, (3) KMS config snapshot and audit export. Need to confirm retention windows. @sanjay-ops can you pull the logs and rotation artifacts?

sanjay-ops: On it. I'll pull from vault-audit S3 and CloudTrail. Quick Q: do you want full raw CloudTrail or a filtered set (kms:Decrypt, DescribeKey, CreateKey, RotateKey, ReEncrypt, GenerateDataKey)? Recommend filtered CSV first.

external_auditor_jones: Filtered is fine as long as it includes the export attempt. We also need signed approval for any manual rotation (who authorized + ticket). And the exact log for the billing job (job id, region, timestamps).

emily-security: Copy. Ticket for the manual rotation should be in INC-4721. I'll attach a redacted approval PDF. Sanjay — can you also capture the API request/response snippet from the keystore-proxy logs so the auditor can repro?

sanjay-ops: Repro command we have recorded:
```
# repro: billing job key export attempt
curl -X POST "https://private.redwood-inference.internal/v1/keystore/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{SERVICE_TOKEN_REDACTED}}" \
  -d '{"key_id":"alias/infra-billing-2024","format":"wrapped"}'
```
Logs show: 403 Forbidden on first attempt, 3x retries, then several 429s from the request rate limiter. I'll include raw event IDs.

emily-security: Note: HSM-backed keys are non-exportable; API should return 400/403. We need to show who triggered the job and why the client attempted export. @oncall-ops can you check for infra ACL/deploy changes in that window (Nov 9–11)?

oncall-ops: Checked infra: no ACL rule changes in that window. There was a deploy 2024-11-10 21:55 UTC affecting keystore-proxy (rollout 1.2.18). Deploy marker present in logs at 2024-11-10T21:56:03Z. Emergency manual rotation happened 2024-11-10T22:50:12Z per rotation agent.

emily-security: That matches our internal notes. Retention policy summary: raw CloudTrail + keystore logs retained 90 days hot, 12 months archived (cold). For SOC2 we will provide the export covering Nov 6–12 plus a SHA256 digest manifest for chain-of-custody and a signed attestation PDF.

external_auditor_jones: Good. Please provide: (a) filtered CSV event dump, (b) signed manifest + SHA256s, (c) redacted ticket + approvals, (d) repro steps and raw request/response snippets. Delivery via secure transfer preferred.

emily-security: Plan: initial evidence bundle uploaded to secure evidence bucket tomorrow noon PST; full raw export by EOD. Will include redacted ticket and signed manifest. :ok_hand:

keystore-bot: Automated: evidence package created: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2024-11-keystore-package-1850004321.tar.gz (internal only).

sanjay-ops: Uploading filtered CSV now. Sample rows (sanitized):
2024-11-07T03:12:17Z,kms:RotateKey,arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-1111,user:svc-rotations,src_ip:34.210.12.4,request_id:abcd-1001
2024-11-10T22:50:12Z,kms:RotateKey,arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-1111,user:emergency-ops,src_ip:52.203.45.9,request_id:abcd-2002
2024-11-10T22:51:03Z,kms:GenerateDataKey,arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/infra-billing-2024,user:billing-job-42,src_ip:10.20.30.40,request_id:abcd-3003,status:403

external_auditor_jones: Got the sample. I'll review and follow up if anything missing. Thanks everyone.

emily-security: Thanks — looping in legal for the approval PDF, will post the pre-signed link here when ready.

external_auditor_jones: Received, confirming timeline. Will respond with any follow-ups by EOD Thu. Thanks.
